entry.title: Με το στίγμα του Ισραήλ
entry.summary: Athens's close alliance with Netanyahu draws Ankara's reaction and creates side-effects in Greece's ties with other Middle East states. Israel's volatile posture has become a fixed parameter of Greek foreign policy.

entry.title: Εγκρίθηκε η είσοδος της Chevron στο Βlock 10 του νοτίου Ιονίου
entry.summary: Greece approved Chevron's entry into Block 10 in the southern Ionian alongside HELLENiQ ENERGY via a farm-in. It is the fifth concession where the US major now operates in the country.

entry.title: Επλήγη η «καρδιά» της Λαύρας – «Το θέαμα ήταν εφιαλτικό»
entry.summary: A Russian strike deliberately hit the historic Kyiv Pechersk Lavra, a UNESCO monument and symbol of Orthodox Christianity with ties to Mount Athos. The Greek ambassador witnessed the destruction firsthand.

entry.title: Ενοπλες Δυνάμεις: Κυνήγι τεχνολογίας στις ΗΠΑ
entry.summary: Defense Minister Nikos Dendias traveled to the US for contacts with firms and research institutes in robotics, artificial intelligence, cyber-defense and unmanned systems. The aim is to equip the Navy with drones.

entry.title: Ιράν: Νέος γύρος συνομιλιών με τις ΗΠΑ από την Παρασκευή
entry.summary: Iranian FM Abbas Araghchi announced a new round of Iran-US talks starting Friday in Switzerland, aiming for a final deal after an interim agreement took effect. He warned that an Israeli attack on Lebanon would breach the ceasefire.

entry.title: Η μείωση των ροών στη «βαλίτσα» του Σαντάμ Χαφτάρ
entry.summary: Migration dominated talks in Athens between Saddam Haftar, son of eastern Libya's marshal, and FM George Gerapetritis, as flows to Crete now come almost exclusively from Benghazi. Maritime-zone delimitation was also on the table.

entry.title: G7: Ο Ζελένσκι επιχειρεί να πείσει τον Τραμπ ότι η Ρωσία χάνει τον πόλεμο
entry.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky arrived at the G7 summit in Evian, seeking to convince Trump that Russia is losing the war and that stronger international support is needed. Trump had arrived buoyed by the framework deal with Iran.

entry.title: Πρόωρη αποπληρωμή δανείων 6,94 δισ. ευρώ
entry.summary: Greece made an early repayment of €6.94bn in first-bailout (GLF) loans, drawing on the ESM "hard cushion" and cash reserves. The goal is to repay the loans ten years ahead of schedule, by 2031.

entry.title: Νέα Δημοκρατία: «Εξορμήσεις» σε κάθε χωριό
entry.summary: With Konstantinos Kyranakis taking over as secretary, New Democracy formally launches its pre-election period, aiming to reconnect with its base. Priority goes to areas where polling is weakest, with elections eight to nine months away.

entry.title: Η ειρήνευση στη Μ. Ανατολή δεν φέρνει αποκλιμάκωση των τιμών
entry.summary: The Bank of Greece revised its 2026 inflation forecast up to 3.8% from 3.1%, as Middle East peace won't quickly translate into lower prices. Wage and rent rises plus tourism demand sustain stubborn services inflation.

entry.title: Αχμέτ Νταβούτογλου στην «Κ»: Το Αιγαίο είναι κοινό
entry.summary: In a Kathimerini interview, former Turkish PM Ahmet Davutoglu argued that "the Aegean is shared" and that the Middle East needs a new regional security architecture. He also commented on the contested "Blue Homeland" bill.

entry.title: Aνακούφιση στην Ασία από το άνοιγμα του Ορμούζ
entry.summary: A possible US-Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz would bring short-term relief to Asia, hit hard by the war. Still, the crisis shock—currency pressure, inflation, supply-chain congestion—may last until year-end.

entry.title: Ο Ντόναλντ Τραμπ απειλεί με δασμό 100% στα γαλλικά κρασιά
entry.summary: Donald Trump threatened a 100% tariff on French wines and champagne unless France scraps its 3% digital-services tax. The threat came just before the G7 summit in Evian.

entry.title: Ιδιοκτήτες και ενοικιαστές γλιτώνουν το τέλος περιφερειακής ανάπτυξης
entry.summary: A planned regional-development levy on electricity bills that would have burdened property owners and tenants was ultimately avoided. A local-development fee replaces older charges, albeit with higher rates.

entry.title: Υπό πίεση το σχέδιο Τραμπ για «χαλαρή» εποπτεία της ΑΙ
entry.summary: The Trump administration's recent restrictions on AI firm Anthropic cast doubt on whether the promised "laissez-faire" approach to AI regulation can hold. Industry figures fear the cooperation framework is collapsing.

entry.title: Οι κατάλληλες περιοχές για ανάπτυξη πυρηνικού σταθμού στην Ελλάδα
entry.summary: A preliminary assessment by Athlos Energy with US firm Cambrian Nuclear flags Thrace and southern Evia as more suitable for potential nuclear plants due to lower seismic risk. Enhanced specs could widen the map.

entry.title: Ποιον λάκκο έχει το γκάλοπ;
entry.summary: Pollsters and analysts explain why the credibility of opinion polls has been shaken, attributing it not just to disgruntled critics but to structural problems and political excesses. The issue is sharpened by the anti-establishment climate eroding the electoral process.

entry.title: Θεωρείο: Τηλεφωνήματα κατά ριπάς
entry.summary: Per the "Theoreio" column, Antonis Samaras keeps reaching out to center-right figures with a clear right-wing background to run in the next elections. The reporting rebuts those who think he is bluffing.

entry.title: Διαρροή emails αποδήμων: Ενοχή για Ασημακοπούλου και Σταυριανουδάκη για δύο αδικήματα ζητά η εισαγγελέας
entry.summary: The prosecutor sought a guilty verdict for ex-MEP Anna-Michelle Asimakopoulou and former interior ministry secretary Michalis Stavrianoudakis over breach of confidentiality and data protection in the diaspora email-leak case before the 2024 Euro-elections. A single-count guilt was sought for Koromilas and Theodoropoulos.

entry.title: Ρωσία: Ζημιές στο μεγαλύτερο διυλιστήριο της Μόσχας από ουκρανικό drone
entry.summary: A Ukrainian drone attack damaged the largest refinery in the Moscow region, owned by Gazpromneft, with no casualties per Mayor Sobyanin. It was unclear whether operations were affected.
